test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some white are car.

II. No truck is car.

**Conclusion:**

I. All truck are white.

II. Some car are white.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

solution:
The pattern followed here is:

The least possible Venn diagram is shown below according to the given information.

Statements:

I. Some white are car.

II. No truck is car.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5ab4671f4f1b71ff9a9e4e12070e31d721edd583937fd8507394b243111bc52.png] 

Conclusion:

I. All truck are white → **Does not follow **→ As some white are car and no truck is car. So all trucks are white is not possible because some part of white is car. So it is incorrect.

II. Some car are white → **Follow **→ As some white are car. So some car are white is followed. 

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
